# Ancient Rome for Kids

> > Educational resource for children and teachers exploring Ancient Roman civilization, engineering, daily life, mythology, and achievements.

This site provides classroom-ready materials about Ancient Rome, covering topics from Roman engineering marvels like roads and aqueducts to everyday life in Roman houses and apartments. Content is specifically designed for kids and teachers with historical timelines, primary sources, and engaging lessons on Roman innovations.

## Key Topics

- Ancient Rome
- Roman Engineering
- Roman Roads
- Aqueducts
- Roman Achievements
- Roman Housing
- Daily Life in Rome
- Roman Mythology
- Roman Soldiers
- Educational Resources
- Classroom Materials
- Roman Innovations
- Ancient Civilizations
- Primary Sources

## Roman Engineering & Achievements

- [Ancient Rome - Achievements and Inventions for Kids and Teachers](https://rome.mrdonn.org/achievements.html): Roman innovations: arches, concrete, mosaics, calendar, law & more
- [Ancient Rome for Kids - The Great Builders, Roman Roads, Milestones, Aqueducts](https://rome.mrdonn.org/builders.html): Roman engineering: roads, aqueducts, and ancient infrastructure guide

## Daily Life & Culture

- [Houses and Apartments in Ancient Rome for Kids](https://rome.mrdonn.org/houses.html): Educational guide on Roman housing, apartments, and daily life for kids
- [Ancient Rome - Myths and Legends for Kids and Teachers](https://rome.mrdonn.org/myths.html): Roman mythology and legends classroom resources for kids and teachers

## Primary Sources & Historical Records

- [Inscriptions & Letters from Ancient Roman Soldiers for Kids](https://rome.mrdonn.org/inscriptions.html): Primary sources: Roman soldier inscriptions and letters for students

## Reference Materials

- [Timelines for Ancient Rome for Kids and Teachers](https://rome.mrdonn.org/timelines.html): Historical timelines of Ancient Rome for educational reference
